limitations: The Rigin–Meinhardt master was supplied locally by the user; it was not fetched by this workflow. The YouTube page displayed Creative Commons Attribution when checked 2026-10-04; preserve RUSFENCING-TV attribution.

The 714.7-second master is indexed for review, but pose preparation is bounded to 120 seconds per clip. One 7.5-second crop-stable excerpt was analyzed at 12 fps; two assistant visual suggestions remain provisional and no human-reviewed intervals were created.
A 30-second excerpt spanning the camera reframe tracked 69/360 samples (19%) and remains playback-only; exclude its pose output from training decisions.
The other four listed videos remain reference leads; no local video files or frame-by-frame analyses exist for them.
FISU highlight edits are materially less useful for lower-body footwork than the wide RUSFENCING bouts.
